scope: Isolated native-browser W0 engine probe on macOS arm64. This records a hidden CEF host against a local fixture; it does not add product web-service wiring, a GUI surface, credentials, remote debugging, external-browser attachment, or a local-model runtime.
sanitization: Public URLs, repository-relative paths, artifact digests, tool versions, and bounded observations only. No user account, host name, private path, credential, raw page payload, or model output is embedded.

source_digest.algorithm: sha256 over repository-relative path, NUL, bytes, and NUL for each listed source, in sorted order

implementation.download_policy: The runner is explicit and opt-in; normal quality does not download CEF.
implementation.hidden_runtime: The host sets NSApplicationActivationPolicyProhibited, creates an Alloy windowless browser, and is launched with --disable-gpu for this software-rendered probe.
implementation.input_path: Host-to-browser CefBrowserHost mouse and key APIs; no page-dispatched synthetic input.
implementation.inspection_path: In-process CEF DevTools observer and ExecuteDevToolsMethod; no remote-debugging TCP endpoint.
implementation.teardown_contract: CloseBrowser(true), then OnBeforeClose releases browser and DevTools references and quits. A bounded check retries forced close and, if close never completes, exits nonzero before CefShutdown rather than quitting with a live browser. The host writes a completion marker only after CefShutdown returns, and the runner requires that marker plus natural exit of every already-sampled descendant PID.
implementation.failure_deadline_basis: Two-second initial close grace, then one-second forced-close retries through an eight-second deadline. The deadline is deliberately below the roughly ten-second Chromium macOS shutdown watchdog observed in failing exploratory runs; it bounds this probe and is not a CEF close guarantee.

behavior.frame_geometry: 800x600 BGRA converted to bounded P6 evidence
behavior.frame_hash_claim: Pixel hashes vary with paint timing; they are evidence of real frames, not a deterministic snapshot contract.

agent_state_direction.prior_art_result: Userscript, Playwright/Puppeteer, extension, and browser-agent precedents favor host-owned semantic accessibility snapshots, content-derived stable refs, action-time re-resolution, bounded actionability checks, epochs and bounded diffs, and trusted embedder input. Arbitrary caller JavaScript, extension capability grants, debugger attachment, and page-dispatched input remain rejected for the future public surface.
agent_state_direction.w1_schema_direction: lapis.web.page-state/1 should expose semantic roles, names and states, frame and shadow boundaries, geometry/visibility/affordance, content-derived refs, navigation/view epochs, bounded diffs, and explicit degraded/bootstrap health. Stale refs must reject rather than guess.
agent_state_direction.firefox_derived_model_concept: Firefox's separate inference process, revision-pinned runtime and model records, verified downloads, allowlist and bounded cache are a useful future isolation pattern. Any local classifier must be advisory only: it may annotate a semantic snapshot, but cannot act, focus, navigate, approve, or replace deterministic state.

non_claims: No services/web directory, lapis web CLI, product GUI surface, multi-view engine tree, or public API was added.
Only a local fixture was loaded; no public website, authentication flow, credential store, download, upload, clipboard, or payment path was exercised.
The isolated host used no-sandbox for this local probe and is not a product sandbox or redistribution policy.
No CEF SDK/signing/redistribution inventory was completed; Developer ID signing is outside this W0 change.
One-view RSS and timings are observations, not an eight-view workload or latency budget.
The host was launched with --disable-gpu; this is a software-rendered windowless path, not GPU compositing or a BGRA-to-Qt upload measurement.
Accessibility, DOM, and Runtime DevTools methods were exercised on the fixture, but no cross-frame, SPA navigation, stale-ref, reconnect, or W1 diff behavior was tested.
No Firefox code, model file, inference runtime, or classifier was downloaded or executed.
